column2: Oh my! What a handsome man!!
Welcome to $$欲情$$ City, $$ベギルド$$! Make yourselves at home!
Welcome! I've got all sorts of fine goods in stock!
Oh my, you look very strong!!
Oh nooo!!
To think there is a man in this city who does not know me!
Welcome to $$ベギルド$$. Do you find our city to your liking?
I am $$アスタルテ$$, this city's $$領主$$.
You see that we are wanted fugitives and feel nothing about it?!
After all the wars, there are so few men left...
If you like this city, you are welcome to make your home here.
If you are strong... heehee! I do not care what color your $$羽$$ are!
After all, this city is...
a wonderful city of $$欲情$$!!
$$欲情$$? Does that mean anyone is fine, as long as they are strong?
Of course! Forbidden $$欲情$$ with a strong gentleman... ahh, it is irresistible!!
Oh, this one here... Such a quiet person!
They do say that no strong man is overly talkative...
This woman is really getting on my nerves...
That $$領主$$ is awfully frivolous...?!
Do you know anything about $$大邪神$$ armor?
Let me think...
I have heard that this city once possessed such armor as well...
But two or three years ago, it was stolen from the church inside the city's temple...
I know nothing of what happened after that...
I have no interest in it, either!!
What? I have not done anything wrong...
Probably.
After all, only women work in this city,
or perhaps not!?
Hey, do you know someone named $$グザファン$$?
They say he is using money to build an army and search everywhere for a child called $$マルコ$$...
Oh, you cannot come to this city and not stop by my place!
Want to drop in for a moment?
Stop by
Do not stop by

“Wait, just...!”
“Waaah...!”
“W-what...?”
I-I... I think that was a weapon shop.
Uh, no, I mean... it was a b-bakery! That shop was!
I have... grown up a little.
Well, I am old now, you see!
Come again...
She is driving me crazy!!
Ridiculous...
